response.overview: A mysterious woman is hiking in the mountains, looking for a place to burry a small metallic box that she’s carrying. She meets a man who is willing to drive her up the hills to her location. A dreamy short about the random meet - ups, the memories we carry, and those we want to leave behind in order to move on. My own interpretation of Giorgos Gousis’s ‘’Magnetic Fields’’.
response.tagline: We all carry something deep within.
response.title: Where Our Memories Rest
